$comment: Four moments, and four photographs that are actually of them.
This file exists because the section it feeds is the one place on the site
where a picture is the argument. Everywhere else a photograph illustrates a
country that has a dataset behind it; here the photograph is the point, and
the words are written to what is in the frame rather than the other way
round. That inverts the usual risk: the danger is not a missing picture, it
is a picture that promises something the frame does not contain.
So a moment has a `lens`, which is a real category a visitor can filter on,
and it does not have a country. Three of these four frames cannot be placed
with certainty — a desert camp is a desert camp, and naming it Merzouga
because it looks like Merzouga is the kind of small invention this site does
not make. Table Mountain can be named because it is unmistakable and the
photograph contains Devil's Peak, Lion's Head and Table Bay. It still is not
named in the copy, because then one of the four would carry a place and the
other three would look as though they were hiding one.
`alt` describes what is visible and nothing else. No moods, no adjectives
about the people in the frame, and no claim about who they are: the same rule
people.json sets out at greater length.
`photo` must be under /images/uploads/. A generated picture here would be the
worst possible place for one — it is a full-bleed promise of a specific
morning, three screens above a button that says begin a journey.

moments.label: Rainforest
moments.line: Hear the forest before you see it.
moments.alt: A silverback mountain gorilla sitting in dense green undergrowth on a forested slope while a line of trekkers and guides photograph it from a few metres away

moments.label: Desert
moments.line: Walk into a landscape that looks impossible.
moments.alt: A camp of white canvas tents and a low striped awning pitched on open sand, with the sun just clear of the dunes on the horizon behind them

moments.label: Coast
moments.line: Walk out at sunrise, where the boats already are.
moments.alt: A woman walking along the tideline at sunrise, silhouetted against the water, with an outrigger fishing canoe moored a short way offshore

moments.label: Mountain
moments.line: Climb the one that rises straight out of the sea.
moments.alt: A flat-topped mountain and its two flanking peaks seen across a bay at sunset from rocks in the foreground, with surf breaking and a container ship at anchor
